## Summary

Built full administration interfaces for Groups (/dashboard/admin/groups), Roles (/dashboard/admin/roles), and Permissions (/dashboard/admin/permissions). Added Server Actions in features/admin/actions.ts for managing group memberships (with batch email pasting) and role permission matrices (with modular grouping and ungrantable checkbox protection). Verified with tsc, oxlint, next build, and pgTAP suite.

## Decisions

- **Structure permission matrix by functional module (rbac, mail, agenda, etc.)**: Allows administrators to quickly configure capability groups without scanning a flat list of permissions.
- **Disable permission checkboxes the user cannot grant**: Prevents unauthorized privilege escalation at the UI layer while RLS enforces it in the database.
